name: Joel
bio: Joel son of Pethuel prophesied to Judah following a devastating locust plague, describing it as a foretaste of the coming "day of the LORD." He called the people to repent with fasting and weeping rather than mere outward ritual, promising that the LORD would then restore what the locusts had devoured and pour out his Spirit on all people, with the sun and moon darkening before that great day arrives. He also envisioned a final judgment of the nations in the valley of Jehoshaphat for their mistreatment of Israel, and the renewed blessing and security that would follow for God's people (Joel 1:1-3:21). He is a different figure from Joel, Samuel's eldest son.
